entries.zh: 生疮；疮疖熟化出脓头（criar postema 直译），即长疮
entries.en: to bring an abscess or boil (postema) to a head; to grow a sore

entries.zh: 生子无孝：养儿不孝——养育其身、指望其出力服侍，却得不到孝行回报
entries.en: to raise a son who shows no filial piety; to rear a child's body and draw no service or labor in return

entries.zh: 奉养：供养、养育（此条对照抚养孩童）
entries.en: to nourish and provide for; to bring up and rear children

entries.zh: 养饲：抚养、喂养孩童
entries.en: to rear and feed children; to bring up
entries.notes: 汉字「飼/餇」存疑且 M 栏两字声调均污损（T99），释义依 L 栏 criar niños 与 R 栏读音互证。

entries.zh: 畜养：养育、驯养（此条对照养育孩童）
entries.en: to raise, nurture and rear (children); to keep

entries.zh: 门下：门下仆从、家仆（旧时称主家仆役）
entries.en: servant, retainer; house servant ('one under the gate')
entries.notes: M 栏并载两条以「l.」起首的变体读音，缩写展开未定；主释义「门下＝仆从」由四栏互证。

entries.zh: 囝仔：小孩；此处兼指仆童、奴仆
entries.en: boy, child; here: servant boy, slave
entries.notes: R 栏读音与「囝仔」不合且汉字「囝/叭」存疑；西语 esclavo（奴仆）限定义项为仆童。

entries.zh: 宫中：宫中仆从、内侍
entries.en: servant of the palace; palace attendant

entries.zh: 甲人食（汉字作「家人食」，疑家/甲）：受雇于人、靠雇主吃饭的雇工
entries.en: hired servant, hireling; one fed at another's table for service
entries.notes: 汉字「家/甲」存疑：M 栏读音近「甲人食」，R 栏近「家人食」，按西语 criado alquilado（雇仆）定为受雇而食之义。

entries.zh: 家内：家中之人、家仆/家眷
entries.en: servant or member of the household; domestic ('of the house')

entries.zh: 家人：家中仆从/家人
entries.en: household servant; member of the family

entries.zh: 后头：家中之人、家仆（闽语「后头」今多指妻方娘家，此处据原典对照家中仆从）
entries.en: servant or person of the household; in Hokkien usage also the wife's natal family
entries.notes: 「后头」今义多指娘家，与西语 criado de casa 对应较松，据本页 criado de casa 同系列（家内/家人/后头）四栏互证定为家中仆从。

entries.zh: 内头囝仔：内宅僮仆、家内小厮
entries.en: boy-servant of the inner household; domestic page
entries.notes: 汉字「囝/叭」存疑；西语 capa（披风）或指贴身侍从，释义依四栏读音与同页系列互证。

entries.zh: 门下：仆从、家仆
entries.en: servant, retainer ('under the gate')
entries.notes: M 栏两字声调均污损（T99），西语词头「criado de Um.」缩写展开未定；门下仆从义与第 6 条互证。

entries.zh: 令价：仆人、己之仆从（谦称，类「小价」）
entries.en: servant, slave; one's humble servant

entries.zh: 令厮：我的仆人、仆役
entries.en: my servant; lackey

entries.zh: 小厮：僮仆、少年仆役（司膳食者之帮手）
entries.en: servant boy, lackey; the steward's (pantry-man's) aide

entries.zh: 小价：谦称己之仆从、仆役
entries.en: my (humble) servant; petty servant
entries.notes: M 栏两字声调均污损（T99）；「小价」谦称己仆之义依汉字、R 栏读音与西语 criado mio 互证。

entries.zh: 小仆：僮仆（女主人家使唤的仆役）
entries.en: boy-servant of the mistress; servant of the lady of the house
entries.notes: M 栏「僕」字声调污损（T99）；释义依汉字、R 栏读音与西语其余各栏互证。

entries.zh: 熙耀（照耀）：明亮；此条对照勤快、利落的仆从，字义存疑
entries.en: diligent servant; lit. 'shining, brilliant'
entries.notes: 汉字「熙/照」存疑且字义（照耀＝明亮）与西语 diligente（勤勉）对应较松，据 M、R 栏读音一致互证暂定为该义项。
